subject: community-medicine
title: Antenatal Care, Maternal Mortality, and Safe Motherhood Schemes

steps.title: Schedule of antenatal visits
steps.tx: Every pregnant woman should register early and complete at least four **antenatal visits in pregnancy**, ideally in the first trimester, then between fourteen and twenty six weeks, twenty eight and thirty four weeks, and thirty six weeks to term. Each visit records weight, blood pressure, pallor, oedema, fundal height, fetal heart sounds, haemoglobin, urine albumin and sugar, blood group, and syphilis and HIV screening after consent.
steps.say: Four antenatal visits are the minimum, starting in the first trimester. Every visit checks blood pressure, haemoglobin, urine, weight, and the growing uterus.

steps.title: Iron folic acid and tetanus protection
steps.tx: An anaemia free pregnancy rests on **iron folic acid supplementation in pregnancy**: one hundred milligrams of elemental iron with five hundred micrograms of folic acid daily for six months, starting after the first trimester, and doubled in dose for women already anaemic. Deworming follows in the second trimester where hookworm is endemic. Two doses of tetanus and diphtheria toxoid protect mother and newborn against tetanus.
steps.say: Iron and folic acid run for six months in pregnancy, twice daily if she is already anaemic. Two Td doses protect her and the baby from tetanus.

steps.title: Identifying the high risk pregnancy
steps.tx: A **high risk pregnancy** carries a raised chance of maternal or perinatal death and needs delivery at a first referral unit with blood and caesarean facilities. Warning flags include age below eighteen or above thirty five years, height under one hundred forty centimetres, previous caesarean or stillbirth, severe anaemia, hypertension, diabetes, twins, malpresentation, and bleeding at any stage of pregnancy.
steps.say: Short stature, severe anaemia, high blood pressure, a previous caesarean, and bleeding mark a high risk pregnancy. Such women must deliver where surgery and blood are available.

steps.title: Maternal mortality ratio and rate
steps.tx: The **maternal mortality ratio** counts maternal deaths during pregnancy or within forty two days of its end, per one hundred thousand live births in the same period; India's ratio fell to ninety seven in 2018 to 2020. The maternal mortality rate instead divides by women of reproductive age. Direct causes like haemorrhage dominate, while anaemia and sepsis act as major indirect contributors.
steps.say: Maternal mortality ratio is deaths per one hundred thousand live births. India reached ninety seven, against a Sustainable Development Goal target of seventy by 2030.

steps.title: Causes of maternal death and the three delays
steps.tx: Postpartum haemorrhage, eclampsia, sepsis, obstructed labour, and unsafe abortion cause most deaths, and the **three delays model of maternal death** explains why women die despite treatable disease. The first delay is late recognition and decision to seek care, the second is late arrival at a facility, and the third is late treatment after arrival because blood, staff, or theatre time is missing.
steps.say: Most mothers die of bleeding, fits, infection, or blocked labour. Deaths follow three delays: deciding to go, reaching the hospital, and getting treated there.

nodes.label: Delay 1: problem not recognised at home
Delay 2: transport to facility is late
Delay 3: blood or surgery unavailable on arrival

steps.title: Birth preparedness and complication readiness
steps.tx: For every pregnancy the family should complete **birth preparedness and complication readiness**: choose the delivery institution in advance, save money, arrange transport and a blood donor, and know the danger signs of bleeding, convulsions, severe headache, blurred vision, fever, and reduced fetal movement. Skilled birth attendance and institutional delivery convert this readiness into survival when labour starts.
steps.say: Birth preparedness means the institution, transport, money, and blood donor are decided before labour. Families must also know the danger signs that need urgent care.

steps.title: The partograph in labour
steps.tx: Cervical dilatation plotted against time on the **partograph for monitoring labour** exposes slow progress hours before obstruction injures mother and baby. Plotting starts in the active phase at four centimetres; the alert line expects one centimetre per hour, and crossing the action line four hours to its right mandates referral or intervention. Fetal heart, contractions, pulse, blood pressure, and urine share the same sheet.
steps.say: The partograph plots cervical opening against time. Crossing the action line means labour is too slow and the woman needs referral or intervention.

steps.title: Postnatal visits and maternal schemes
steps.tx: Half of maternal and newborn deaths cluster in the first week, so **postnatal visits after delivery** are scheduled within twenty four hours, at forty eight to seventy two hours, at seven days, and at six weeks for institution and home births alike. Janani Suraksha Yojana pays cash for institutional delivery, Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram removes all user charges, Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan guarantees a specialist antenatal check each month, and LaQshya certifies labour room quality.
steps.say: Postnatal checks run from the first day to six weeks, because the first week is the deadliest. Government schemes now pay for, and quality certify, institutional care.

steps.title: Maternal death review
steps.tx: Every maternal death must be notified within twenty four hours and reviewed under **maternal death surveillance and response**, which combines facility based review of case records with community based verbal autopsy at home. Review committees classify the cause, identify the delay responsible, and issue corrective orders on staffing, blood banks, referral transport, and drug stocks so the same failure does not kill again.
steps.say: Each maternal death is reviewed at the facility and in the community. The review names the delay and fixes the system gap that caused it.
